en: A vintage black-and-white (sepia-toned) street scene showing a gently sloping urban street lined with multi‑story stone and brick buildings on the left and large trees and a substantial institutional-looking building with a cross on top on the right. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the street, and a handcart is visible. At the bottom margin, printed in red, are the words indicating the city and street name.
